title: JPL counter clerk hands over negatives of "the old city on Mars"

tellings.quote: he went oh this is the old city on Mars

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, a clerk at the counter of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in California handed over photo negatives from the mapping of Mars and is said to have remarked, "oh this is the old city on Mars." Joe McMoneagle, author of the book Mind Trek, tells Michels this as something he was there for. If true, it would mean people at the lab casually spoke of a city on Mars.
